host.description: Whois server hostname to query (RIPE NCC default).

port.description: Port number for the Whois server connection.

regid.description: Registry identifier (e.g., RIPE-NCC, LIR name) to locate allocations; '.' is translated to '-' in uppercase.

arg.description: Positional argument: either regid or prefix (e.g., 192.0.2.0/24).

options.description: Output and validation flags; each is optional and defaults to false if omitted.

options.approval.description: Validate networks under allocation and report valid/invalid entries.

options.assign.description: Print assignments under allocations with size, date, netname, and status.

options.status.description: Report assignments with non-standard status attributes.

options.contacts.description: Print admin-c and tech-c for all inetnum objects.

options.na.description: Expected netname for --approval/--aw checks; matches against allocation netname.
